cases.name: glow-salon.example.json: approvers: every mistake
errors: I don't know what "more" means in "approvers". Allowed: people, twoAboveInr.
I don't know what "extra" means in approvers.people[0]. Allowed: id, whatsapp, language.
approvers.people[0].id must be a short name in lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter (for example "ravi"), and not "owner".
approvers.people[0].whatsapp must start with + and the country code, then digits only, for example +919800000002.
approvers.people[0].language must be one of hi, en, ml, kn.
approvers.people[1].id must be a short name in lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter (for example "ravi"), and not "owner".
approvers.people[2].whatsapp is already the owner's or another person's number: each person answers from their own phone.
approvers.people[3].id "x" is listed twice: each person has their own id.
approvers.people[4] must be {"id": "ravi", "whatsapp": "+919800000002", "language": "hi"}.
"approvers.twoAboveInr" must be a whole number of rupees: refunds above it need two different people.
